transcript.text: Could you make a reel from these five café photos I’ve attached? I’ve been looking forward to putting these together, but I’m not very good at making a set of photos feel like one video. What I mean is a 10-second vertical Instagram reel, using all five pictures in the order attached: the storefront pic, the latte pic, the pastries pic, the barista pic, and the interior pic. Please add some relaxed instrumental music to go with them. I’m hoping this will be a nice way to share the café photos rather than just leaving them sitting on my phone. There shouldn’t be any text, just nice smooth transitions between the photos.

Your café reel is ready! 🎬☕

Download it here (the link works for 24 hours, so save a copy):
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbhsxwp04edgq0164zfd07k/output.mp4?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T022500Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

What I asked for:
• 10 seconds, vertical 9:16 (480×858), so it fits an Instagram reel
• All five photos in your order, about 2 seconds each: storefront → latte → pastries → barista → interior
• Soft cross-dissolve transitions with a slow, gentle camera push-in on each shot
• Relaxed instrumental café music (soft guitar and piano, no vocals) built into the video
• No text or captions

Please check two things before you post:
• Magic Hour has no plain "photo slideshow" tool. So an AI video model made this reel using your five photos as references. It doesn't place the original photos on screen exactly as they are. The shots should look very close to your photos, but small details may be different. I couldn't watch the video myself, so please play it through and check that each shot looks right and that the order and transitions are correct.
• It's 480p, which is the highest resolution on the free plan. That's fine on a phone screen but a little soft on bigger screens.

It used 240 credits. If a shot looks off or you'd like a different feel (slower pace, different music mood), tell me and I can make a new version.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished 10-second vertical café reel with a download link. It lists what was made and adds caveats: AI-generated shots based on the photos, 480p resolution, and 240 credits used. It asks the user to check the video, but it does not ask for a choice or approval before proceeding.
